findings.mayaSelectionAndTargetIdentity: Both camps select the opposing Noble Six only. The special selection displays 2,4 S and the secondary displays 1,2 S, with unchanged 5000/5000 HP.
findings.mayaVisibleEffect: Purple rings and vertical suspension surround the selected opponent in all four impact captures; Maya has a hand gesture rather than an allied shield or firearm.
findings.mayaRuntimeCorroboration: The current proof records exactly one control event per flow, HP5000→5000, controlTicks143 for special and71 for secondary; expiry and pause stability are recorded by the browser proof, not inferred from still images.
findings.valSelection: Both camps select Val herself and nearby Markov, each with SOIN1400. Distant Maggie and the opposing Noble Six are excluded.
findings.valVisibleEffect: A local green healing pulse surrounds Val; selected allied bars rise while distant Maggie remains low and the opponent stays intact. No Medgun beam or launched projectile is visible.
findings.valRuntimeCorroboration: The current proof records Val/Markov1500→2900, Maggie1500→1500 and opposing Noble Six5000→5000 in each camp.
findings.ui: P2 labels, action names, selected-side colours, target cards, duration/heal labels and confirm/cancel controls remain legible in the selection captures.

limitations: Static captures establish the visible selected/impact states; they do not independently measure complete animation timing, pause duration or expiry. Those are separate assertions in the fresh source browser proof.
This review does not certify source frames or official1:1 visual reproduction.
